name.description: Unique agent name within the tree. A valid identifier; cannot be "user".

description.description: One line other agents read to decide when to delegate here.

model.description: Model id; its prefix picks the provider (gemini-*, claude-*, gpt-*/o*, grok-*, ollama/*).

fallback_model.description: A model on another provider that answers when this agent's model fails provider-side (5xx, 429, network) before producing anything, or while that provider's circuit is open (ADR 0044).

globalInstruction.description: Instruction applied to every agent in the tree; only the root agent's value takes effect.

tools.description: Named tools from lib/toolRegistry.ts (e.g. web_search, web_extract, wiki_search).

require_approval.description: Tools from this agent's `tools` that run only after a person approves the exact call (ADR 0028): the A2A task ends input-required until the caller answers approve or reject. Allowed on the orchestrator and on plan-dispatch routes.

outputKey.description: Session-state key the final reply is saved under.

includeThoughts.description: Stream the thinking trace in the response.

thinkingConfig.description: Older spelling of `reasoning` for Gemini and Claude (thinkingLevel or thinkingBudget). Cannot be combined with `reasoning`.

reasoningEffort.description: Older spelling of `reasoning` for the chat-completions and Responses providers. Cannot be combined with `reasoning`.

generateContentConfig.description: Model generation config (@google/genai GenerateContentConfig). Do not set tools here.

budget_tokens.description: Thinking tokens; 0 = none. Effort-only providers take the nearest level at or above it.

reasoning.description: How hard this agent reasons, on any provider: none | low | medium | high, or { budget_tokens: <int> }. Replaces generateContentConfig.thinkingConfig and reasoningEffort (ADR 0047).

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for structured output. Cannot be combined with AgentTool delegation.

mcp_server_url.description: MCP server (SSE) whose tools are discovered at runtime and merged with `tools`.

mcp_tools.description: The MCP server's tools this agent may use, by name; any other tool the server lists is not exposed. Without it, every listed tool is. require_approval may name these. Needs mcp_server_url.

dir.description: A directory of skills: one subdirectory per skill, named as its SKILL.md frontmatter names it. Relative to the working directory.

scripts.description: Whether a skill's scripts/ may run. "local" runs them on this machine, each after a person approves (ADR 0028); default "none".

tools.description: Registry tool names a skill may unlock through its `allowed-tools` frontmatter once it is loaded. Omitted, no skill unlocks anything.

skills.description: Agent Skills (SKILL.md directories) this agent reads the way a coding harness does.

spec.description: An OpenAPI 3 spec file (.yaml, .yml, .json), relative to this syndicate file. Files only, never URLs.

operations.description: Operations to expose, by operationId or tool name. Omitted: every GET operation, and nothing that writes.

base_url.description: Overrides the spec's servers[0].url. Checked by the SSRF guard.

prefix.description: Prepended to each tool name, to keep two APIs apart.

auth.description: Credentials, always from the environment, never written in YAML.

bearer_env.description: Environment variable holding a bearer token.

api_key.description: An API key read from `env`, sent in a header or the query under `name`.

items.description: An HTTP API as tools, from its OpenAPI spec (lib/tools/openapiTools.ts).

code_execution.description: "gemini": the model writes and runs Python in Gemini's server-side sandbox; nothing runs on this host. Gemini models only.

context.description: Summarize a long conversation instead of overflowing the window. The orchestrator of a delegate syndicate only.

compact_after_tokens.description: Compact when the last request's prompt passed this many tokens.

keep_recent_events.description: Events kept verbatim after the summary. Default 6.

summary_model.description: The model that writes the summary. Default: the agent's own.

examples.description: Few-shot exchanges (input, output) added to every request's instruction.

mode.description: "task": the agent works until it calls finish_task; its arguments (matching outputSchema) are the node's output. Workflow nodes only.

subagents.description: The orchestrator's team. Omit it (or write `subagents: []`) for a single-agent syndicate.

keep_recent_events.description: Events kept verbatim after the summary. Default 6.

summary_model.description: The model that writes the summary. Default: the agent's own.

examples.description: Few-shot exchanges (input, output) added to every request's instruction.

mode.description: "task": the agent works until it calls finish_task; its arguments (matching outputSchema) are the node's output. Workflow nodes only.

yaml_reference.description: A whole nested syndicate (filename under the agents dir) used as this subagent.

a2a_agent_url.description: A remote agent over A2A: the server base URL or its agent-card URL. Needs no model or instruction; credentials come from A2A_AGENT_TOKENS, never YAML.

items.description: A subagent: an inline agent, a nested syndicate (yaml_reference), or a remote A2A agent (a2a_agent_url).

default_route.description: Subagent used whenever routing yields no usable answer. Must name a declared subagent.

route_key.description: JSON property holding the chosen route. Default "route".

reason_key.description: JSON property holding the justification. Default "reason".

route.description: Subagent to run on a match.

pattern.description: JS regular expression source tested against the raw message.

reason.description: Shown to the waiting user as the [STATUS] route note.

anyOf.description: Several nodes: fan-out when they follow one node, fan-in when one node follows them.
A routing map after a node: `{ <route>: <node or nodes>, default: <node> }`, matched against that node's output.

edges.description: Chains of nodes, each a list; `START` begins at least one. A routing map follows the node whose output it routes.

ask_user.description: Pause and ask the person this; the reply becomes the node's output.

schema.description: JSON Schema a structured reply to ask_user must satisfy; plain text passes as is.

map.description: Run this agent once per item of a list input, concurrently; output the list of results.

tool.description: Run this registry tool with the node input as its arguments.

route_key.description: Property of a JSON output holding the route. Default "route".

max_attempts.description: Attempts including the first; 1 = no retry. ADK default 5.

timeout.description: Seconds this node may run before it fails.

additionalProperties.description: A declared node (exactly one of ask_user, join, map, tool) or modifiers for an agent node (retry, timeout, route_key).

max_concurrency.description: Nodes that may run at once. Default: unbounded.

workflow.description: Opts into a WORKFLOW: the syndicate as a graph (lib/workflow.ts). Cannot be combined with dispatch.

retries.description: Self-correction on model and tool errors (ADK reflect-and-retry plugins). On by default.

model_errors.description: Retries of a malformed model reply. Default 2; 0 off.

tool_errors.description: Retries of a tool that threw, with reflection guidance. Default 3; 0 off.

variables.description: Defaults for {{token}} interpolation. {{current_date}} is built in.

memory_namespace.description: Where long-term memory is stored: the syndicate name plus a generated id, written once and never recomputed (ADR 0020). Syndicates that declare the same namespace share memory.

memory_extraction_rules.description: Domain rules appended to the fact-extraction prompt (long-term memory only).

memory_extraction_model.description: The model that distils this syndicate's turns into memory records; default MEMORY_EXTRACTION_MODEL (ADR 0020).

memory_retention_days.description: Days a memory fact is kept in this syndicate's namespace; older facts are deleted daily. Needs memory_namespace (ADR 0020).

max_steps.description: Hard cap on model calls per turn, subagents included. Default 50 (DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS) when unset.

bundled_references.description: Written by the registry publisher, not by hand: every nested yaml_reference this syndicate reaches, as it was when published, so a registry version is one unit (ADR 0018). Nested references load from here instead of from files.
